abstract: [Abdominal radiology (New York)] Human epidermal growth factor receptor 2 (HER2) is an important predictive and prognostic biomarker that guides targeted therapy, particularly in breast and gastric cancers. Conventional HER2 assessment using immunohistochemistry (IHC) and fluorescence in situ hybridization (FISH) is limited by inter-observer variability, heterogeneous expression, and diagnostic complexity. This systematic review and diagnostic meta-analysis followed the PRISMA 2020 guidelines to evaluate Artificial Intelligence-based HER2 assessment. Fifty-one studies were included in the qualitative synthesis and 14 in the diagnostic meta-analysis. Bibliometric analysis, methodological taxonomy, comparative evaluation, and pooled diagnostic performance were assessed, with study quality evaluated using QUADAS-2. AI methodologies have rapidly evolved from conventional machine learning and radiomics to deep learning, Vision Transformers, explainable AI, and multimodal frameworks, with histopathology and Magnetic Resonance Imaging. being the most frequently used modalities. Research activity increased markedly between 2023 and 2025. Pooled sensitivity was 87.8%, specificity was 83.5%, and Summary Receiver Operating Characteristic Area Under the Curve (SROC AUC) was 0.852 (95% CI: 0.801-0.881), indicating promising overall diagnostic performance. Deeks' funnel plot asymmetry test showed no significant evidence of publication bias (p = 0.14). However, heterogeneity warrants cautious interpretation of the pooled estimates. Heterogeneous datasets, limited external validation, and inconsistent evaluation methods remain important barriers to clinical implementation. Future research should emphasize multicenter prospective validation, explainable and multimodal AI, foundation models, federated learning, and evaluation in underexplored malignancies, including gallbladder cancer.
zh_abstract: [Abdominal radiology (New York)] 人表皮生长因子受体2（HER2）是一种重要的预测和预后生物标志物，可指导靶向治疗，尤其在乳腺癌和胃癌中。使用免疫组织化学（IHC）和荧光原位杂交（FISH）的常规HER2评估受限于观察者间变异性、表达异质性和诊断复杂性。本系统综述和诊断性meta分析遵循PRISMA 2020指南，评估基于人工智能的HER2评估。51项研究纳入定性综合，14项纳入诊断性meta分析。评估了文献计量分析、方法学分类、比较性评价和合并诊断性能，并使用QUADAS-2评价研究质量。AI方法已从传统机器学习和影像组学迅速发展到深度学习、视觉Transformer（Vision Transformers）、可解释AI和多模态框架，其中组织病理学和磁共振成像（Magnetic Resonance Imaging, MRI）是最常用的模态。2023年至2025年间研究活动显著增加。合并灵敏度为87.8%，特异度为83.5%，汇总受试者工作特征曲线下面积（SROC AUC）为0.852（95% CI：0.801-0.881），表明总体诊断性能有前景。Deeks漏斗图不对称性检验未显示显著的发表偏倚证据（p = 0.14）。然而，异质性要求对合并估计值进行谨慎解读。异质性数据集、有限的外部验证和不一致的评估方法仍是临床实施的重要障碍。未来研究应强调多中心前瞻性验证、可解释和多模态AI、基础模型、联邦学习，以及在包括胆囊癌在内的研究不足恶性肿瘤中的评估。

abstract: [Journal of the American Medical Informatics Association : JAMIA] Ambient artificial intelligence (AI) scribes are rapidly becoming normalized in clinical practice, yet governance frameworks focus on accuracy, privacy, consent, and medicolegal status. Risks to clinician capabilities have received less attention. Speak before the reveal is a proposed method in which clinicians verbalize critical cognitive steps, such as synthesis and plan, before note generation. Recent work distinguishes deskilling in senior clinicians, never-skilling from premature offload in trainees and mis-skilling, the internalization of AI errors and inappropriate use as sound practice. This Perspective builds on emerging evidence that reasoning before seeing AI output may protect unaided reasoning. Training implementation, evaluation, adherence challenges, validation methodology, and governance strategies for training bodies, health services, and scribe vendors are discussed. Speak before the reveal is a low-cost, testable approach to maintaining clinical reasoning for individuals or organizations. Successful AI scribe adoption requires preserving clinicians' ability to work without AI support.
zh_abstract: ［《美国医学信息学协会杂志：JAMIA》］环境式人工智能（AI）记录员（AI scribes）正在临床实践中迅速常态化，然而治理框架主要关注准确性、隐私、知情同意和医疗法律地位。对临床医生能力受损的风险关注较少。“先口述后揭示”（Speak before the reveal）是一种提出的方法，即临床医生在生成病历记录之前，将关键的认知步骤（如综合判断和计划）口头表达出来。近期研究区分了资深临床医生的去技能化（deskilling）、受训者因过早认知卸载而出现的“从未习得技能”（never-skilling），以及“错误习得技能”（mis-skilling），即将AI错误和不恰当使用内化为合理实践。本观点文章基于新出现的证据：在查看AI输出之前进行推理可能保护无辅助推理能力。讨论了面向培训机构、医疗服务机构和记录员供应商的培训实施、评估、依从性挑战、验证方法和治理策略。“先口述后揭示”是一种低成本、可检验的方法，可用于为个人或组织维持临床推理能力。成功采用AI记录员需要保留临床医生在没有AI支持时工作的能力。

title: DeepTNR: predicting tumor drug sensitivity from spatial transcriptomics with deep graph contrastive and transfer learning

abstract: Heterogeneity within the tumor microenvironment remains a major obstacle to precision oncology. Although existing drug-sensitivity models can capture transcriptional heterogeneity, they generally do not account for the spatial organization of predicted drug responses. Here, we developed DeepTNR, a spatially resolved framework that integrates tumor-stroma interface features, spatial autocorrelation, and distance-dependent associations between local cellular composition and predicted drug sensitivity. Across nine tumor types, with colorectal cancer (CRC) as a representative example, DeepTNR identified irinotecan as the most sensitive drug and revealed significant spatial autocorrelation in its predicted response patterns. Spatial proximity effect analysis further showed that local enrichment of immune and proliferative programs positively was associated with increased irinotecan sensitivity. Together, these findings demonstrate the potential of DeepTNR to resolve intratumoral therapeutic heterogeneity and identify niche-specific vulnerabilities.
zh_abstract: 肿瘤微环境内的异质性仍然是精准肿瘤学的主要障碍。尽管现有的药物敏感性模型能够捕捉转录异质性，但它们通常没有考虑预测药物反应的空间组织。在此，我们开发了DeepTNR，一个空间分辨框架，整合肿瘤-间质界面特征、空间自相关以及局部细胞组成与预测药物敏感性之间距离依赖的关联。在九种肿瘤类型中，以结直肠癌（CRC）为代表示例，DeepTNR识别伊立替康为敏感性最高的药物，并揭示其预测反应模式具有显著空间自相关。空间邻近效应分析进一步显示，免疫和增殖程序的局部富集与伊立替康敏感性增加呈正相关。总之，这些发现证明了DeepTNR在解析瘤内治疗异质性和识别生态位特异性脆弱性方面的潜力。

abstract: [Science (New York, N.Y.)] Microvascular anastomosis, the surgical suturing of small-caliber blood vessels, is technically demanding, time-consuming, and prone to failure from complications such as thrombosis. Existing adhesives are ineffective in the dynamic, wet surgical field, particularly for the limited cross-sectional interface of blood vessels. We present an integrated microneedle-interlocking adhesive system (iMAS) bioinspired by plant root anchoring. This platform combines a hydrophobic polymeric matrix with tetrahedral microneedles, creating robust, three-dimensional bonding for rapid, secure anastomosis. An embedded artificial intelligence (AI)-assisted wireless sensor enables continuous, real-time monitoring of vascular hemodynamics and cardiac graft health, facilitating predictive identification of complications such as stenosis and transplant rejection. In rat models, iMAS reduced procedural time by 78% and suppressed neointimal hyperplasia. iMAS streamlines microvascular anastomosis and enables proactive graft monitoring in transplantation.
zh_abstract: [Science (New York, N.Y.)] 微血管吻合，即小口径血管的手术缝合，技术上要求高、耗时，并且易因血栓形成等并发症而失败。现有黏合剂在动态、潮湿的手术野中无效，特别是对于血管有限的横截面接口。我们提出一种受植物根系锚定启发的集成微针互锁黏合系统（iMAS）。该平台将疏水性聚合物基质与四面体微针相结合，形成牢固的三维黏合，用于快速、安全的吻合。一个嵌入式人工智能（AI）辅助无线传感器能够连续、实时监测血管血流动力学和心脏移植物健康，有助于预测性识别狭窄和移植排斥等并发症。在大鼠模型中，iMAS将手术时间缩短78%，并抑制新生内膜增生。iMAS简化了微血管吻合，并使移植中的移植物监测具有前瞻性。

zh_title: LLMSurvival：端到端、可处理删失的LLM生存分析

abstract: [Journal of biomedical informatics] Survival analysis is central to medical prediction, yet large language models (LLMs) are rarely used as end-to-end survival models because censoring prevents straightforward supervised fine-tuning. Here we present LLMSurvival, a framework that enables censoring-aware survival analysis with unmodified LLMs operating directly on tabular clinical data. LLMSurvival reformulates time-to-event prediction as pairwise ranking among comparable subjects, and derives test-time risk by aggregating comparisons against anchor individuals from the training cohort. Across two clinical tasks (ICU mortality prediction in MIMIC-IV and fragility fracture prediction in a NewYork-Presbyterian/Weill Cornell Medicine cohort), LLMSurvival improves overall concordance over Cox proportional hazards modeling by 3.1% for ICU mortality and 0.5% for fracture risk, and by 2.1% on average for ICU mortality and 2.8% for fracture risk over three established deep learning survival models. The results show that survival modeling with censoring can be made compatible with LLM fine-tuning through comparison-based reformulation. The framework demonstrates high portability and superior performance over expert-curated scores like SAPS-II and FRAX scores across diverse clinical contexts. Furthermore, the framework supports local deployment, as compact, publicly available base models provide sufficient performance. The LLMSurvival framework serves as a proof of concept for an integrated, censoring-conscious approach to survival analysis via LLMs.
zh_abstract: [Journal of biomedical informatics] 生存分析是医学预测的核心，但大型语言模型（LLMs）很少被用作端到端生存模型，因为删失（censoring）阻碍了直接的监督微调。在此，我们提出 LLMSurvival，一个框架，能够使用未经修改的 LLMs 直接处理表格临床数据进行删失感知的生存分析。LLMSurvival 将时间-事件预测重新表述为可比较受试者之间的成对排序，并通过聚合与训练队列中锚定个体的比较来推导测试时风险。在两个临床任务中（MIMIC-IV 中的 ICU 死亡率预测和 NewYork-Presbyterian/Weill Cornell Medicine 队列中的脆性骨折预测），LLMSurvival 相比 Cox 比例风险模型提高了总体一致性：ICU 死亡率提高 3.1%，骨折风险提高 0.5%；相比三个已建立的深度学习生存模型，ICU 死亡率平均提高 2.1%，骨折风险平均提高 2.8%。结果表明，通过基于比较的重新表述，可以使带有删失的生存建模与 LLM 微调兼容。该框架表现出高可移植性，并在多种临床情境中优于专家制定的评分（如 SAPS-II 和 FRAX 评分）。此外，该框架支持本地部署，因为紧凑的、公开可用的基础模型即可提供足够性能。LLMSurvival 框架可作为通过 LLMs 进行整合的、具有删失意识的生存分析的概念验证。

abstract: With a rise in the incidence of cardiovascular disease in ageing populations worldwide, physicians will face a substantial increase in demand for feasible and accurate diagnostics. title: A frontier machine intelligence for human neuroimaging

abstract: Medical imaging is essential for diagnosing disease, guiding treatment and monitoring patients over time. Although artificial intelligence has advanced image interpretation, existing medical models often address restricted tasks, while general-purpose proprietary models lack access to private clinical imaging required to achieve medical expertise. Developing models that can interpret complex examinations and communicate their findings in the context of clinical decisions remains a major challenge. Here, we show that Neuro-VL, a vision-language model trained on nearly one million neuroimaging studies from routine clinical care, can interpret complete imaging examinations and engage in natural language conversations about their findings. Across internal and international datasets, Neuro-VL outperformed frontier general-purpose and specialized medical models in diagnosing, localizing, and describing abnormalities, as well as generating comprehensive radiology reports. The model also compared serial examinations to assess disease progression and more reliably resisted misleading clinical assumptions than leading frontier models from OpenAI and Google. These results extend health system learning beyond individual predictions to interactive image interpretation and longitudinal disease monitoring. They demonstrate how the collective clinical experience of health systems can be used to develop medical AI with specialized expertise and broad clinical capabilities.

abstract: [Newly registered clinical trial, no results yet; sponsor: Chimei Medical Center; conditions: Nursing Care Planning; type: INTERVENTIONAL; phase: NA; enrollment: 120; status: COMPLETED] This study evaluates whether assistance from a large language model (LLM), a type of artificial intelligence that generates text, improves the quality of nursing care plans and reduces the time needed to complete them. The study included 120 registered nurses working in internal medicine wards, surgical wards, and intensive care units at a medical center in southern Taiwan. Nurses were randomly assigned to one of two groups: * Independent planning: Nurses prepared, reviewed, and submitted a care plan without LLM assistance. * LLM-assisted planning: Nurses entered prompts to obtain an LLM-generated draft, then reviewed and revised the draft before submitting their final care plan. The nursing care decision quality assessment has a maximum total score of 30 points, comprising decision-content quality (25 points) and decision-language quality (5 points). The system recorded task completion time. Researchers compare the two groups' final care-plan quality scores and task completion times.

title: Detecting Contradictory Evidence on Drug-Disease Associations at Scale

abstract: Contradictory claims about drug efficacy across randomized controlled trials (RCTs) complicate evidence-based medicine, yet existing automated methods classify isolated sentence pairs and do not explain why studies disagree. We present DrugCon, a large language model (LLM)-based framework that extracts study conclusions from RCT abstracts, links these claims when they concern the same drug-disease association, detects contradictions with counterfactual reasoning, and explains them using a taxonomy of ten study-level factors such as population, dosage, and outcome measures. Applying DrugCon to 224,756 RCT abstracts, we built DrugCon-Bench, an exhaustively annotated benchmark of 542 contradictory claim pairs from 819 abstracts. Most contradictions involve more than one study-level factor (75.5%). The most common are differences in outcome measures (64.0%), populations (51.3%), and dosage or exposure duration (35.6%). DrugCon achieves an F1 score of 0.744 for contradiction detection, outperforming rule-based, supervised, and natural language inference baselines, and an F1 of 0.482 for identifying explanatory study factors. DrugCon enables scalable and explainable analysis of contradictory clinical evidence.
zh_abstract: 随机对照试验（RCTs）之间关于药物疗效的矛盾主张使循证医学复杂化，然而现有的自动化方法对孤立的句子对进行分类，并不解释研究为何不一致。我们提出 DrugCon，一个基于大型语言模型（LLM）的框架，从 RCT 摘要中提取研究结论，当这些主张涉及同一药物-疾病关联时将其链接起来，通过反事实推理检测矛盾，并使用包含十个研究层面因素（如人群、剂量和结局指标）的分类体系来解释矛盾。将 DrugCon 应用于 224,756 篇 RCT 摘要，我们构建了 DrugCon-Bench，一个对来自 819 篇摘要的 542 对矛盾主张进行详尽标注的基准。大多数矛盾涉及不止一个研究层面因素（75.5%）。最常见的是结局指标差异（64.0%）、人群差异（51.3%）以及剂量或暴露持续时间差异（35.6%）。DrugCon 在矛盾检测上的 F1 分数为 0.744，优于基于规则、监督学习和自然语言推理的基线；在识别解释性研究因素方面的 F1 为 0.482。DrugCon 能够对矛盾的临床证据进行可扩展且可解释的分析。

abstract: Background. Distributed learning lets hospitals train prediction models jointly without exchanging patient records, but how the benefits of a swarm network change as it grows, and which hospitals gain most, have so far been studied with artificial partitions of single-center databases. We examined network scaling on real hospitals that differ in size, volume and sepsis prevalence. Methods. We applied the seven-KPI swarm-learning evaluation framework (Swarm Gain, Local Gain, Relative Local Gain, Model Stability Index, Jain's index, Data Utility Index and label entropy) to progressive network scaling on the eICU Collaborative Research Database. From 25 hospitals (71,887 ICU stays; sepsis prevalence 16.6%), six hospitals stratified by bed size (two small, two medium, two large; 14,776 stays) formed networks of two, four and six hospitals in all six category-joining orders; four further hospitals served as substitutes in robustness checks. Feature distributions were near-identical across hospitals (Data Utility Index 0.005-0.013), whereas the change in label entropy tracked Swarm Gain (r = 0.74). Substituting alternative medium or large hospitals left network AUROC between 0.790 and 0.805. Conclusions. zh_abstract: 【背景】分布式学习使医院能够在不交换患者记录的情况下联合训练预测模型，但群体网络随规模增长其收益如何变化，以及哪些医院获益最多，迄今仍是利用单中心数据库的人工划分进行研究的。我们在规模、业务量和脓毒症患病率不同的真实医院中考察了网络扩展。【方法】我们将七项KPI的群体学习评估框架（群体增益Swarm Gain、本地增益Local Gain、相对本地增益Relative Local Gain、模型稳定性指数Model Stability Index、Jain指数、数据效用指数Data Utility Index和标签熵）应用于eICU Collaborative Research Database上的渐进式网络扩展。从25家医院（71,887例ICU住院；脓毒症患病率16.6%）中，按床位规模分层选取六家医院（两家小型、两家中型、两家大型；14,776例住院），按全部六种类别加入顺序组建由两家、四家和六家医院组成的网络；另外四家医院在稳健性检查中作为替代医院。采用NVIDIA FLARE的客户端控制工作流程（联邦平均，30轮，五个随机种子）模拟群体学习。任务是基于离散化生命体征、实验室和药物特征，用1,313参数前馈网络进行全程脓毒症分类，以AUROC为指标。【结果】网络AUROC在每种顺序中随每次添加而增加，从两家医院时的0.734（小院优先）、0.755（中院优先）和0.781（大院优先），增至六家医院时的0.804（标准差0.002）。群体增益在所有九个独特转变中均超过1（两家增至四家医院的平均值为1.042，四家增至六家为1.020）。每家医院的本地增益均低于1；相对于本地训练的改善幅度从最强医院的4.1%（本地AUROC 0.773）到最弱医院的29.5%（0.621），小医院平均25.5%，大医院平均5.9%。加入大医院给现有成员带来最大增益（平均相对本地增益+6.2%）；加入小医院从未降低该增益。种子间变异性从两家医院时的变异系数2.2%降至六家医院时的0.2%。各医院间特征分布几乎相同（数据效用指数0.005–0.013），而标签熵的变化与群体增益相关（r = 0.74）。替换为其他中型或大型医院后，网络AUROC保持在0.790至0.805之间。【结论】在真实多医院数据上，参与群体学习改善了每家医院的模型，对本地模型最弱的医院改善最大，且没有任何一次添加会损害网络。

title: Breath-Dx: A Time Series Classification Benchmark for Disease Screening with eNose
zh_title: Breath-Dx：呼气电子鼻疾病筛查基准
summary: 基于1234例、九个诊断组的公开电子鼻数据，构建首个呼气疾病筛查时间序列分类基准，并考虑传感器漂移。

abstract: Electronic nose (eNose) technology offers a portable, non-invasive route for disease screening via exhaled breath analysis. However, progress in the field is hindered by the lack of systematic benchmarks that compare machine learning methods under realistic conditions, particularly sensor drift, a known but rarely quantified failure mode. Most existing studies rely on small, private datasets with inconsistent protocols, rendering results non-comparable and slowing progress. We introduce Breath-Dx, the first comprehensive benchmark of time series classification methods for breath-based disease screening. Our work leverages the Scent of Health (S-OH) dataset, the largest public clinical eNose collection to date, comprising 1,234 patients across nine diagnostic groups, each providing a 17-channel multivariate time series with explicit temporal train/test splits that account for sensor drift. We systematically evaluate 10 methods spanning four families: feature-based tabular learners, convolution-based models, graph-based, and time series architectures. All methods degrade significantly under temporal validation (0.05-0.12 AUC drop compared to random cross-validation), confirming that drift embeds a strong temporal signal. Under this realistic evaluation, the best methods achieve ROC AUC of 0.74-0.76 for some lung conditions, though others remain near chance. Recurrent architectures show the most consistent performance across diseases, while specialized time series methods achieve the highest peak results. Demographic confounders matter: breath signals provide independent diagnostic value for some conditions but add little beyond age for others. We release the S-OH dataset, all temporal splits, evaluation protocols, and code to enable reproducible research and accelerate progress in clinical breathomics.
zh_abstract: 电子鼻（electronic nose, eNose）技术通过呼出气分析为疾病筛查提供了一种便携、非侵入性的途径。然而，该领域的进展受到缺乏系统性基准的阻碍，这些基准应在现实条件下比较机器学习方法，特别是传感器漂移——一种已知但很少被量化的失效模式。大多数现有研究依赖小型私有数据集和不一致的方案，使结果不可比较并减缓进展。我们推出 Breath-Dx，这是首个用于基于呼气疾病筛查的时间序列分类方法的综合基准。我们的工作利用 Scent of Health（S-OH）数据集，这是迄今为止最大的公开临床 eNose 数据集集合，包含九个诊断组的 1,234 名患者，每位患者提供 17 通道多变量时间序列，并具有考虑传感器漂移的明确时间训练/测试划分。我们系统评估了涵盖四个家族的 10 种方法：基于特征的表格学习器、基于卷积的模型、基于图的模型和时间序列架构。所有方法在时间验证下均显著下降（与随机交叉验证相比 AUC 下降 0.05-0.12），证实漂移嵌入了强时间信号。在这种现实评估下，最佳方法对某些肺部疾病达到 ROC AUC 0.74-0.76，而其他疾病仍接近随机水平。循环架构在疾病间表现最一致，而专门的时间序列方法达到最高峰值结果。人口学混杂因素很重要：呼吸信号对某些疾病提供独立诊断价值，但对其他疾病在年龄之外几乎没有增加信息。我们发布 S-OH 数据集、所有时间划分、评估协议和代码，以实现可重复研究并加速临床呼吸组学进展。

title: CaseScope: A Multi-Field Benchmark for Case-Level Pathology Diagnosis with Multimodal LLMs
zh_title: CaseScope：病理病例级多视野基准
summary: 预印本提出多视野病理诊断基准，含教学库436例与图谱800例，评测多模态大模型。
key_points: 模拟病理医生多视野多尺度阅片
两套数据共1236例病例
图谱病例由双LLM一致标注
reason: 新基准设计有新意但规模中等、未明确开源，预印本限档
abstract: Pathologists rarely diagnose from a single image: they scan a section at low power for architecture, zoom into selected fields for cytology, and integrate the evidence across views and scales. Pathology benchmarks for multimodal large language models (MLLMs), however, mostly ask about one image or require whole-slide pipelines, and the few that show several fields draw nested regions from cancer slides of one public cohort. We introduce CaseScope, a benchmark of diagnosis from several curated fields of one lesion: CaseScope-Teaching, 436 cases from a residency-training image library, reconstructed, de-identified, harmonised against a WHO-based ontology and re-examined by a pathologist wherever an automated pre-review raised a doubt, and CaseScope-Atlas, 800 cases from 88 published atlases (387 of them figure series of one disease), labelled from the captions by two LLMs that must agree. They cover 843 entities across 18 organ systems and pose 4,679 items in six tasks, from open-ended and ten-way diagnosis with ontology-guided hard negatives under circular evaluation to the verification and location of morphological findings. Across twenty-eight open and four proprietary MLLMs, diagnoses are unstable -- the best open and proprietary models are correct under all ten option rotations on 17.9% and 61.7% of the teaching cases -- and wrong answers favour the classic look-alike; open models make little use of the additional fields on teaching cases, where the one-line specimen site matters more, although on atlas cases with three or more fields the fields count about as much as the site; and most open models verify findings barely above chance (median 62.0% vs. 50%, best 81.5%), gaining a median +3.4 points from images; proprietary models reach 83.2-93.2%. Rankings broadly replicate between the sources. The evaluation code is available at https://github.com/Wenchuan-Zhang/CaseScope.
zh_abstract: 病理学家很少仅凭单张图像诊断：他们会以低倍镜扫描切片以观察组织结构，放大选定视野以观察细胞学，并整合跨视图和跨尺度的证据。然而，多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）的病理学基准大多只询问一张图像，或要求全切片流程，而少数展示多个视野的基准从单一公共队列的癌症切片中提取嵌套区域。我们推出CaseScope，一个基于同一病变的若干精选视野进行诊断的基准：CaseScope-Teaching包含436例，来自住院医师培训图像库，经过重建、去标识化、依据基于WHO的本体进行协调统一，并在自动预审提出疑问时由病理学家重新检查；CaseScope-Atlas包含800例，来自88部已出版图谱（其中387例为单一疾病的图组），由两个必须达成一致的大语言模型根据图注进行标注。它们覆盖18个器官系统的843个实体，并在六项任务中提出4,679个条目，从循环评估下带本体引导硬负例的开放式诊断和十选一诊断，到形态学发现的验证与定位。在28个开源和4个专有MLLM中，诊断不稳定——最佳开源模型和最佳专有模型分别在17.9%和61.7%的教学病例中在全部十种选项轮换下均正确——且错误答案偏向经典相似病变；开源模型在教学病例中很少利用额外视野，在这些病例中一行标本部位信息更重要，尽管在具有三个或更多视野的图谱病例中，视野的作用与部位大致相当；多数开源模型对发现的验证仅略高于随机水平（中位数62.0% vs. 50%，最佳81.5%），从图像中获得中位数+3.4个百分点的提升；专有模型达到83.2–93.2%。各来源之间的排名大致可重复。评估代码可在https://github.com/Wenchuan-Zhang/CaseScope获取。

title: Aggregate Accuracy Hides Diagnosis-Specific Failure in Medical Vision-Language Models
zh_title: 总体准确率掩盖医学视觉语言模型的诊断特异性失败
summary: 对五个开源医学视觉语言模型在6048道平衡胸片问题上审计，发现两个模型对全部气胸病例均判为阴性，却仍生成流畅具体的解释。
key_points: 五个开源VLM在6048道ChestX-ray14平衡问题上审计
两个模型对864例气胸问题全部答“否”，平衡准确率0.500
失败跨四种提示格式与原生分辨率持续，且无弃答或保留
reason: 预印本；多模型大规模公开基准审计揭示安全性问题，但非前瞻或外部临床验证
abstract: Medical vision-language models (VLMs) are compared mainly by accuracy averaged across findings, a summary that can hide complete failure on a single diagnosis. We audit five open medical VLMs (MedGemma-4B, Lingshu-7B, HuatuoGPT-Vision-7B, Qwen2.5-VL-7B, and MedVLM-R1) on 6,048 ChestX-ray14 questions balanced by sex, age, finding, and label. On the 432 pneumothorax-positive X-rays, HuatuoGPT-Vision and Qwen2.5-VL detect zero cases while MedGemma and Lingshu detect 38% and 67% of the same images. The two failing models answer "no" to all 864 pneumothorax cases (balanced accuracy 0.500, chance), yet produce fluent, anatomically specific explanations that name the signs of a collapsed lung and then deny them, with no hedge or abstention. This failure is not an artifact of prompting, image resolution, label ambiguity, or model scale. It persists across four prompt formats, at native resolution, and on single-label cases. A within-model control shows the same forced prompt gives HuatuoGPT 79% recall on nodule but only 6% on pneumothorax. It survives a tenfold scale increase (Qwen2.5-VL-72B detects 4%) and replicates on SIIM-ACR, an independent dataset with radiologist-drawn masks, where the failing models detect 0 of 432 confirmed pneumothoraces, including 0 of the 144 largest lesions. Reading the models' logits and internal states shows this is not blindness. The two failing models are highly confident yet no better than chance and a linear probe recovers pneumothorax from their hidden representations even where recall is zero, so the finding is represented internally but suppressed at the output. Aggregate accuracy therefore cannot establish that a medical VLM can see a given finding, because a model that misses one can still describe it convincingly. Reporting per-finding recall and specificity on balanced cases is needed to tell the difference.
zh_abstract: 医学视觉-语言模型（VLMs）主要通过跨发现项平均的准确率进行比较，这种汇总可能掩盖在单一诊断上的完全失败。我们在 6,048 个按性别、年龄、发现项和标签平衡的 ChestX-ray14 问题上审计了五个开放的医学 VLM（MedGemma-4B、Lingshu-7B、HuatuoGPT-Vision-7B、Qwen2.5-VL-7B 和 MedVLM-R1）。在 432 张气胸阳性 X 光片上，HuatuoGPT-Vision 和 Qwen2.5-VL 检出零例，而 MedGemma 和 Lingshu 在相同图像上分别检出 38% 和 67%。这两个失败模型对所有 864 个气胸病例都回答“无”（平衡准确率 0.500，即随机水平），却生成流畅、解剖学上具体的解释，指出肺塌陷的征象，随后又否认这些征象，且没有任何模糊限定或弃答。这一失败不是提示方式、图像分辨率、标签歧义或模型规模的假象。它在四种提示格式、原生分辨率以及单标签病例上持续存在。一项模型内对照显示，相同的强制提示使 HuatuoGPT 在结节上的召回率为 79%，但在气胸上仅为 6%。它在规模扩大十倍后仍然存在（Qwen2.5-VL-72B 检出 4%），并在 SIIM-ACR 上复现；SIIM-ACR 是一个带有放射科医生绘制掩膜的独立数据集，其中失败模型在 432 个确认气胸中检出 0 个，包括在 144 个最大病灶中检出 0 个。读取模型的 logits 和内部状态表明这不是失明。这两个失败模型高度自信，却不优于随机；并且即使在召回率为零的地方，线性探针也能从它们的隐藏表示中恢复气胸，因此该发现项在内部被表征，但在输出端被抑制。因此，总体准确率不能证明医学 VLM 能看到某一给定发现项，因为一个漏掉某一发现项的模型仍然可以令人信服地描述它。需要在平衡病例上报告按发现项的召回率和特异度，才能区分二者。

title: An Asynchronous Federated Learning Platform for Lung Adenocarcinoma Grading via Foundation Models and Structural Pruning
zh_title: 肺腺癌分级的异步联邦学习平台
summary: 提出基于网页的联邦学习系统，仅共享模型权重、不共享患者数据，用UNI2基础模型与CLAM-SB对病理全切片图像进行肺腺癌分级。
key_points: 四客户端联邦系统，机构间仅交换本地训练权重
采用UNI2基础模型结合CLAM-SB分类病理全切片
NLST队列保留仅作外部验证，中心化联合训练优于单机构训练
reason: 预印本；四客户端联邦系统+独立外部验证队列，但尚未见前瞻或临床结局数据
abstract: Classification of lung adenocarcinoma into poorly differentiated (PD) and well-to-moderately differentiated (WMD) subtypes plays an important role in patient survival; however, consistent classification is difficult due to inter-observer variability among pathologists. Collecting data from multiple hospitals is also challenging due to patient privacy concerns. This study proposes a web-based federated learning system that shares only locally trained model weights without sharing patient data between institutions. The UNI2 foundation model and CLAM-SB were used to classify pathological whole slide images. A four-client federated learning system was constructed, and the NLST cohort was reserved exclusively for external validation. In centralized evaluation, joint training with CPTAC and TCGA outperformed single-institution training on external validation, confirming the necessity of multi-institutional data integration. FedAvg, FedProx, FedBN, and FedNova were compared as federated learning algorithms under identical experimental conditions. Test AUC ranked as FedBN, FedProx, FedNova, and FedAvg. FedNova showed the most balanced classification performance between PD and WMD. L1-norm structural pruning at 20%, 30%, and 40% sparsity was applied to reduce model transmission size. FedAvg, FedProx, and FedBN showed a tendency of decreasing Test AUC under pruning, while FedNova achieved improved Test AUC across all sparsity levels. A web-based application was developed supporting slide upload, local training, AI classification, and attention heatmap-based visualization. The combination of FedNova and 40% pruning was confirmed as a practical approach that improves communication efficiency and classification performance while protecting patient privacy.
zh_abstract: 将肺腺癌分类为低分化（PD）和高至中分化（WMD）亚型在患者生存中起重要作用；然而，由于病理学家之间的观察者间差异，一致分类很困难。由于患者隐私顾虑，从多家医院收集数据也具有挑战性。本研究提出一种基于网络的联邦学习系统，仅共享本地训练的模型权重，而不在机构之间共享患者数据。使用UNI2基础模型和CLAM-SB对病理全切片图像进行分类。构建了一个四客户端联邦学习系统，并将NLST队列仅保留用于外部验证。在集中式评估中，使用CPTAC和TCGA联合训练在外部验证上优于单机构训练，证实了多机构数据整合的必要性。在相同实验条件下比较了FedAvg、FedProx、FedBN和FedNova作为联邦学习算法。测试AUC排名为FedBN、FedProx、FedNova和FedAvg。FedNova在PD与WMD之间表现出最均衡的分类性能。应用稀疏度为20%、30%和40%的L1范数结构化剪枝以减少模型传输大小。FedAvg、FedProx和FedBN在剪枝下表现出测试AUC下降趋势，而FedNova在所有稀疏度水平上均实现了测试AUC提高。开发了一个基于网络的应用程序，支持切片上传、本地训练、AI分类和基于注意力热图的可视化。FedNova与40%剪枝的组合被确认是一种实用方法，可在保护患者隐私的同时提高通信效率和分类性能。

title: Mixed Signals: Weight-Space Programming for EEG and ECG
zh_title: 权重空间编程用于EEG与ECG模型
summary: 预印本显示语言模型可直接读取生物信号网络权重，在未告知故障位置的情况下定位并修复问题，甚至从零写出权重。
key_points: 语言模型可调试EEG/ECG模型中植入的隐藏故障
仅凭架构、任务和少量受试者即可从零生成权重
论文称一组实验可匹配梯度下降训练效果
reason: 方法有新意但属预印本，缺外部验证与临床结局，值得一看档
abstract: Weight-space programming allows language models to read a trained neural network's weights and edit them. This opens the door to ``training'' by reasoning rather than through gradient descent. Prior work has demonstrated its functionality and promise for game-playing networks and fixing specific failures in language models, even extending to diffusion models. In this work, we present its applicability to models trained on biosignal data, specifically EEG and ECG data. We show that frontier models are not only able to debug specific faults planted in biosignal-based models without being told what these faults are, but are even capable of writing all the weights of a network from scratch, given only the architecture, the task, and a minimal set of training subjects. In particular, in one set of experiments, a language model was able to match standard gradient-descent training using 6times fewer training subjects, through reasoning alone and without any gradient descent step. Networks written by Claude Opus 5.5 also scored higher than classic hand-crafted EEG pipelines (alpha band power, and common spatial patterns with linear discriminant analysis) when built from the same 5 subjects. We also highlight some of the limitations, which include the inability of language models to improve already well-trained classification models, and their incapacity to reliably recognize, from the weights alone, the task a network was trained on. Overall, our results indicate that weight-space programming can be useful for small networks, such as those deployed on edge devices and wearables, but the concept still requires further investigation before it can be used in practice.
zh_abstract: 权重空间编程允许语言模型读取已训练神经网络的权重并对其进行编辑。这为通过推理而非梯度下降进行“训练”打开了大门。先前的工作已证明其在游戏博弈网络以及修复语言模型中特定故障方面的功能性和前景，甚至扩展到扩散模型。在本工作中，我们展示其适用于基于生物信号数据训练的模型，特别是脑电图（EEG）和心电图（ECG）数据。我们表明，前沿模型不仅能够在未被告知这些故障是什么的情况下调试植入基于生物信号的模型中的特定故障，而且甚至能够仅给定架构、任务和最少的一组训练受试者，就从零开始写出网络的全部权重。特别是，在一组实验中，一个语言模型仅通过推理且不进行任何梯度下降步骤，使用的训练受试者数量少6倍，就能够匹配标准梯度下降训练。当基于相同的5名受试者构建时，由Claude Opus 5.5写出的网络得分也高于经典手工设计的EEG流程（α频带功率，以及结合线性判别分析的共空间模式）。我们还强调了一些局限性，包括语言模型无法改进已经训练良好的分类模型，以及它们无法仅根据权重可靠地识别网络所训练的任务。总体而言，我们的结果表明，权重空间编程对小型网络（例如部署在边缘设备和可穿戴设备上的网络）可能有用，但该概念在能够实际应用之前仍需进一步研究。

title: Artificial Intelligence-Assisted Care After Hospital Discharge for People With Decompensated Cirrhosis
zh_title: 出院后AI辅助管理失代偿期肝硬化试验
summary: 新注册随机对照试验：3中心180例，评估出院后AI辅助主动管理能否减少90天内非计划再就诊。
key_points: 随机分为常规照护与常规+AI辅助管理
主要结局为90天内肝病相关非计划就医
计划3中心入组180例，尚未招募，无结果
reason: 前瞻性随机设计并设临床结局，但尚无结果、样本仅180例，属值得一看档。
abstract: [Newly registered clinical trial, no results yet; sponsor: Beijing Tsinghua Chang Gung Hospital; conditions: Decompensated Liver Cirrhosis; type: INTERVENTIONAL; phase: NA; enrollment: 180; status: NOT_YET_RECRUITING] This study will compare two ways of supporting adults with cirrhosis after they leave hospital. Cirrhosis is severe scarring of the liver. Eligible participants will have been hospitalized for liver-related complications and will be ready for discharge. The main question is whether adding an artificial intelligence (AI)-assisted management service to usual care reduces unplanned hospital care caused by worsening liver disease during the next 90 days. The study plans to enroll 180 adults at three centers. Participants will be assigned by chance, with an equal chance of receiving usual care alone or usual care plus AI-assisted proactive management. Participants receiving the additional service, or their authorized caregivers, will complete a brief daily health report taking about 3-5 minutes and may report symptoms when they occur. The system helps organize reports and identify information requiring attention. Nurses check the information, and physicians make clinical decisions. The system does not independently diagnose illness, prescribe treatment, or change medication. Both groups will continue their usual medical care and have study follow-up contacts on days 7, 30, 60, and 90. The study will compare unplanned emergency visits, hospital observation, acute same-day treatment, and readmissions related to worsening liver disease. Safety and the burden of using and delivering the service will also be assessed. Participants with urgent symptoms should seek emergency care without waiting for a response from the study platform.
zh_abstract: [新注册临床试验，尚无结果；申办方：北京清华长庚医院（Beijing Tsinghua Chang Gung Hospital）；疾病：失代偿性肝硬化（Decompensated Liver Cirrhosis）；类型：干预性（INTERVENTIONAL）；分期：不适用（NA）；入组人数：180；状态：尚未招募（NOT_YET_RECRUITING）] 本研究将比较两种在肝硬化成人患者出院后为其提供支持的方式。肝硬化是严重的肝脏瘢痕化。符合条件的参与者将因肝相关并发症住院，并已达到出院条件。主要问题是，在常规照护基础上增加人工智能（AI）辅助管理服务，是否可减少未来90天内因肝病恶化导致的计划外医院照护。该研究计划在三个中心入组180名成人。参与者将通过随机方式分配，接受单独常规照护或常规照护加AI辅助主动管理的几率相等。接受额外服务的参与者或其授权照护者将完成一份简短的每日健康报告，耗时约3-5分钟，并可在症状出现时进行报告。系统帮助整理报告并识别需要关注的信息。护士核对信息，医生做出临床决策。系统不独立诊断疾病、开具治疗或更改用药。两组均将继续其常规医疗照护，并在第7、30、60和90天进行研究随访联系。研究将比较与肝病恶化相关的计划外急诊就诊、医院观察、急性当日治疗和再入院。还将评估安全性和使用及提供该服务的负担。出现紧急症状的参与者应立即寻求急诊照护，而不应等待研究平台的回复。

abstract: [PLOS digital health] Artificial intelligence (AI) chatbots are being explored to deliver health coaching across multiple contexts. However, the quality and safety of chatbot-generated advice is influenced by how prompts are constructed, and prompt design remains inconsistently described in the literature. This scoping review examined how prompt design has been applied and evaluated in AI health coaching chatbots and summarized the study designs, prompt strategies, and outcomes reported across studies. We conducted a scoping review following PRISMA-ScR guidance and searched PubMed, Embase/Ovid MEDLINE ALL, PsycINFO, IEEE Xplore, and Scopus for peer-reviewed studies published up to October 2025. Eligible studies examined prompt design in large language model-based health coaching chatbots. Data were extracted using a standardized form and synthesized narratively. Twelve studies were included, spanning mental health, medication use, physical activity, and nutrition contexts. Study designs were primarily simulation-based, with few involving real users. Prompt strategies were grouped into structural modifications, prompting techniques, and role-based approaches. Structural modifications, such as increasing specificity and adding constraints, were most common and were reported to improve response quality and clarity. Prompting techniques were reported to improve task performance but sometimes reduced focus or consistency. Role-based prompting influenced tone, specificity, and guideline alignment. Outcomes focused mainly on response quality, with fewer studies assessing safety or user experience and only one evaluating clinical outcomes. Prompt design is a key, modifiable determinant of chatbot performance. However, current evidence is limited by heterogeneous study designs and minimal real-world evaluation. Greater focus on prompt design is needed to improve the quality and safety of AI-delivered health coaching and its real-world impact on health outcomes.
zh_abstract: [PLOS digital health] 人工智能（AI）聊天机器人正被探索用于在多种场景中提供健康教练服务。然而，聊天机器人生成建议的质量和安全性受提示词构建方式的影响，而文献中对提示词设计的描述仍不一致。本范围综述考察了提示词设计在 AI 健康教练聊天机器人中的应用和评估方式，并总结了各研究报告的研究设计、提示词策略和结局。我们遵循 PRISMA-ScR 指南开展范围综述，并检索 PubMed、Embase/Ovid MEDLINE ALL、PsycINFO、IEEE Xplore 和 Scopus，以查找截至 2025 年 10 月发表的同行评审研究。符合条件的研究考察了基于大语言模型的健康教练聊天机器人中的提示词设计。数据采用标准化表格提取，并进行叙述性综合。共纳入 12 项研究，涵盖心理健康、药物使用、身体活动和营养场景。研究设计主要基于模拟，少数涉及真实用户。提示词策略被归为结构性修改、提示技术和基于角色的方法。结构性修改（如提高特异性、增加约束）最常见，并据报道可改善回答质量和清晰度。提示技术据报道可改善任务表现，但有时会降低聚焦度或一致性。基于角色的提示影响了语气、特异性和指南一致性。结局主要集中于回答质量，较少研究评估安全性或用户体验，仅有一项研究评估临床结局。提示词设计是聊天机器人性能的关键且可修改的决定因素。然而，当前证据受研究设计异质性和真实世界评估不足的限制。需要更多关注提示词设计，以提高 AI 提供的健康教练服务的质量和安全性及其对健康结局的真实世界影响。

abstract: [Computer methods in biomechanics and biomedical engineering] The rising global incidence of arrhythmia calls for reliable detection methods. Most existing approaches suffer from poor generalization and insufficient feature extraction for long-term electrocardiogram (ECG) signals. This work proposes an adaptive multi-scale dilated convolutional network (AMSDNet). It uses multi-scale dilated convolutions, gated adaptive weight allocation, and spatial attention fusion to capture global ECG features. Validated on Massachusetts Institute of Technology-Beth Israel Hospital Arrhythmia Database (MIT-BIH), the China Physiological Signal Challenge (CPSC) 2018, and the Computing in Cardiology Challenge (CINC) 2017 datasets, our method outperforms state-of-the-art models with average accuracy of 99.7%, 91.8% and 83.7%, respectively.

abstract: [Phytotherapy research : PTR] Plant-derived preparations remain widely used, yet their clinical application is constrained by multicomponent composition, batch-to-batch chemical variability, and complex pharmacokinetics, poorly characterized interactions, and marked interindividual variability in response. Artificial intelligence (AI) and computational pharmacology offer analytical tools suited to the high-dimensional data generated by phytomedicine, but enthusiasm has outpaced the supporting evidence. This critical narrative review evaluates AI applications across the phytomedicine pipeline, grading them by the strength and directness of evidence from computational prediction through in vitro, animal, observational, and randomized clinical studies. We organize the field around a Patient-Product-Mechanism-Response (PPMR) framework, arguing that meaningful personalization requires joint characterization of both the patient and the chemically variable botanical product. Current applications are most mature for botanical authentication, spectral annotation, quality assurance, and mechanism-informed hypothesis generation, whereas validated tools for patient stratification, individualized product and dose selection, and improved clinical outcomes remain limited. Rather than claiming efficacy gains, we present AI as a means to advance standardized, mechanism-informed, and testable phytomedicine, contingent on higher-quality data, prospective external validation, and regulatory alignment. The central finding is that none of the studies examined demonstrated a complete AI-guided personalized-phytomedicine pathway from joint patient-and-product characterization through a prospectively validated individualized response; precision phytomedicine should therefore be described as an emerging and hypothesis-generating research programme rather than an established clinical capability.
zh_abstract: [植物疗法研究：PTR] 植物来源制剂仍被广泛使用，但其临床应用受到多组分构成、批间化学变异性、复杂药代动力学、特征描述不足的相互作用以及反应中显著个体间变异性的限制。人工智能（AI）和计算药理学提供了适用于植物药产生的高维数据的分析工具，但相关热情已超过支持性证据。本批判性叙述性综述评估AI在植物药全流程中的应用，并按证据强度和直接性对其进行分级，范围从计算预测到体外、动物、观察性和随机临床研究。我们围绕患者-产品-机制-反应（Patient-Product-Mechanism-Response, PPMR）框架组织该领域，认为有意义的个体化需要同时对患者和化学可变的植物产品进行表征。当前应用在植物基原鉴定、光谱注释、质量保证和机制驱动的假设生成方面最为成熟，而用于患者分层、个体化产品和剂量选择以及改善临床结局的经过验证的工具仍然有限。我们并未声称疗效获益，而是将AI视为推进标准化、机制驱动且可检验的植物药的一种手段，其前提是更高质量的数据、前瞻性外部验证和监管一致性。核心发现是，所审查的研究均未证明一条完整的AI引导的个体化植物药路径——从患者与产品的联合表征，到经前瞻性验证的个体化反应；因此，精准植物药应被描述为一个新兴的、以生成假设为目标的研究计划，而非已确立的临床能力。

abstract: [Nihon Hoshasen Gijutsu Gakkai zasshi] To evaluate how output format affects inference accuracy in contrast-enhanced CT protocol generation using a large language model (LLM) combined with retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) based on information obtained from a radiology information system. A total of 335 contrast-enhanced CT examinations with radiologist-determined protocols were retrospectively analyzed. Among them, 292 cases were used to build the RAG knowledge base, and 43 cases were used for validation. Two types of prompts were prepared: a structured format that outputs each imaging phase (unenhanced, arterial, portal venous, and equilibrium) in binary form (0/1), and a free-text format. The inference results generated by each format were evaluated. Complete agreement across all imaging phases was achieved in 16 of 43 cases (37.2%). Phase-specific accuracies were 76.2% for the unenhanced phase, 64.3% for the arterial phase, 78.6% for the portal venous phase, and 81.0% for the equilibrium phase. In the free-text evaluation, 65.1% of the generated contrast-enhanced CT protocols were rated as either "no issues" or "acceptable." An LLM integrated with RAG may serve as a potential decision-support tool for determining contrast-enhanced CT protocols.

abstract: [Methods in molecular biology (Clifton, N.J.)] Prime editors are newly developed genome editing tools capable of installing various types of mutations without introducing double-strand DNA breaks (DSBs) or requiring donor DNA templates. Prime editors consist of a Cas9 nickase fused to a reverse transcriptase (RT) domain and function as a ribonucleoprotein complex with prime editing guide RNA (pegRNA). Unlike the single guide RNA (sgRNA) used with Cas9 or base editors, the editing efficiency of pegRNAs is determined by the sequence composition and length of the guide sequence, primer binding site (PBS), and reverse transcription template (RTT). The high design flexibility of pegRNAs presents both opportunities and challenges. Therefore, designing pegRNAs with high efficacy has been a significant hurdle for the application of prime editing. Here, we present a step-by-step protocol for designing optimal pegRNAs to introduce desired edits using a deep learning-based algorithm, DeepPrime.

abstract: Objective Negative control outcomes (NCOs) help detect and correct systematic error in observational studies, yet their selection remains largely manual. The Common Evidence Model (CEM) can generate candidate lists, but researchers must still screen them for plausibility as true nulls and for sufficient observation in each institution's data. We developed and evaluated MENTOR (Multi-agent Evidence-informed Negative conTrol Outcome selection with Reasoning), a multi-agent system of large language models (LLMs) that combines CEM evidence with LLM reasoning to select institution-specific NCOs. Methods Four LLM agents operate on an institution's Observational Medical Outcomes Partnership common data model. A Curator summarizes drug labels, a Suggester assesses locally frequent candidates with CEM evidence and a first-pass LLM judgment, an Adjudicator resolves their disagreements, and a Diagnostician relaxes the patient-count threshold until a target number of NCOs is met. Using Qwen3.6-27B, we evaluated 349 candidates for three drug pairs in a Korean tertiary hospital's electronic health records (2.9 million patients) against a blinded LLM judge from a different model family, validated by three experts on 90 candidates. We compared accuracy, positive predictive value (PPV), and sensitivity with CEM-only and first-pass-LLM-only selection. Results MENTOR proposed 243 NCOs versus 121 by CEM-only, with higher accuracy (0.83 [0.79-0.87] vs. 0.53 [0.48-0.58]), sensitivity (0.89 vs. 0.41), and PPV (0.86 vs. 0.79). Judge-expert agreement was {kappa}=0.63. Adjudication, needed for 44.1% of candidates, added little accuracy, and only with reasoning mode. Concordant acceptances, which bypass it, contained about half of the false positives. Only 7%-9% of CEM-proposed outcomes had at least 10,000 patients at the institution. Conclusion Combining LLM judgments with CEM evidence and local data yielded more NCOs, with higher PPV, than CEM alone. Restricting reasoning to discordant candidates kept computation time below 40% of that with reasoning in all agents. Every decision comes with its evidence and rationale for investigators' final review.
zh_abstract: 【目的】阴性对照结局（negative control outcomes, NCOs）有助于检测和校正观察性研究中的系统误差，但其选择在很大程度上仍依赖人工。通用证据模型（Common Evidence Model, CEM）可生成候选列表，但研究者仍须筛选这些候选，以判断其作为真正无效结局的合理性，以及在每家机构数据中是否具有足够的观察量。我们开发并评估了 MENTOR（Multi-agent Evidence-informed Negative conTrol Outcome selection with Reasoning，基于推理的多智能体证据知情阴性对照结局选择系统），这是一个由大语言模型（large language models, LLMs）构成的多智能体系统，它将 CEM 证据与 LLM 推理相结合，以选择特定于机构的 NCOs。【方法】四个 LLM 智能体在机构的观察性医疗结局合作组织（Observational Medical Outcomes Partnership）通用数据模型上运行。一名“策展者”（Curator）总结药品说明书；一名“建议者”（Suggester）结合 CEM 证据和首轮 LLM 判断来评估在本机构常见的候选；一名“裁决者”（Adjudicator）解决二者的分歧；一名“诊断者”（Diagnostician）逐步放宽患者数量阈值，直至达到目标 NCO 数量。使用 Qwen3.6-27B，我们在韩国一家三级医院的电子健康记录（290 万患者）中，针对三个药物对评估了 349 个候选，并以来自不同模型家族的盲法 LLM 评判者作为对照，该评判由三位专家在 90 个候选上进行了验证。我们将准确率、阳性预测值（positive predictive value, PPV）和灵敏度与仅使用 CEM 的选择方法及仅使用首轮 LLM 的选择方法进行了比较。【结果】MENTOR 提出了 243 个 NCO，而仅使用 CEM 的方法为 121 个；MENTOR 的准确率更高（0.83 [0.79-0.87] 对 0.53 [0.48-0.58]），灵敏度更高（0.89 对 0.41），PPV 也更高（0.86 对 0.79）。评判者与专家的一致性为 κ=0.63。裁决环节在 44.1% 的候选上被启用，但其对准确率的提升很小，且仅在推理模式下才有提升。绕过裁决环节的一致接受（concordant acceptances）中包含了约半数的假阳性。在 CEM 提出的结局中，仅 7%–9% 在该机构拥有至少 10,000 名患者。【结论】将 LLM 判断与 CEM 证据及本地数据相结合，相比单用 CEM 可产生更多 NCO，且 PPV 更高。仅对不一致的候选启用推理，使计算时间保持在所有智能体均启用推理时的 40% 以下。每项决策都附带其证据和理由，供研究者最终审核。

title: Multimodal protein representations across human brain cell types
zh_title: SEMPER：跨脑细胞类型的蛋白表征
summary: SEMPER将蛋白语言模型表征与442种成人脑细胞类型的蛋白互作网络对齐，为每个蛋白生成融合序列与网络信息的表征。
key_points: 整合蛋白语言模型与蛋白互作网络两类信息
覆盖成人脑442种细胞类型
意在弥补脑细胞类型在单细胞图谱中占比不足
reason: 预印本新方法，摘要未见基准对比结果，属值得一看档
abstract: The central nervous system (CNS) comprises diverse cell types whose molecular context shapes the roles of the proteins they express. Computational models offer a scalable way to study the roles of proteins across human brain cell types, with protein language models and interactome- or single-cell-based models capturing complementary information encoded in protein sequences and cellular network contexts. Human brain tissue is hard to access, so brain cell types make up a small fraction of the atlases single-cell models train on and of the benchmarks used for their evaluation. To capture these complementary sources of information in the CNS, we introduce SEMPER, a multimodal representation learning model that aligns protein language model representations with protein-protein interaction networks from 442 cell types of the adult human brain, giving each protein a sequence-informed representation in every cell type in which its gene is expressed. We show that SEMPER representations predict cell type-specific protein complexes and predict genes essential to the survival of dopaminergic neurons, measured in a genome-wide CRISPR screen. In zero-shot retrieval, SEMPER recovers clinically pursued drug targets for Parkinson's disease, Alzheimer's disease, multiple sclerosis, Huntington's disease and amyotrophic lateral sclerosis at higher rates than cell type-specific models. To further improve target recovery, we combine SEMPER with a large language model that reasons over protein functional annotations. The combination recovers more targets, with SEMPER providing experimentally derived cellular context that complements literature-based reasoning of the large language model.
zh_abstract: 中枢神经系统（central nervous system, CNS）由多种细胞类型组成，其分子环境塑造了这些细胞所表达蛋白质的功能。计算模型为研究蛋白质在人类脑细胞类型中的作用提供了一种可扩展的方法；蛋白质语言模型以及基于相互作用组或基于单细胞的模型，捕获了编码于蛋白质序列和细胞网络环境中的互补信息。人脑组织难以获取，因此脑细胞类型在单细胞模型训练所用的图谱中、以及在其评估所用的基准中仅占很小一部分。为在中枢神经系统中捕获这些互补的信息来源，我们提出 SEMPER，这是一种多模态表征学习模型，它将蛋白质语言模型的表征与来自成人脑 442 种细胞类型的蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用网络对齐，从而为每个蛋白质在其基因表达的每一种细胞类型中赋予一个由序列信息驱动的表征。我们证明，SEMPER 表征能够预测细胞类型特异性的蛋白质复合物，并能预测对多巴胺能神经元存活至关重要的基因——后者通过全基因组 CRISPR 筛选测定。在零样本检索中，SEMPER 对帕金森病、阿尔茨海默病、多发性硬化、亨廷顿病和肌萎缩侧索硬化中临床关注的药物靶点的召回率高于细胞类型特异性模型。为进一步提高靶点召回，我们将 SEMPER 与一个大语言模型相结合，后者对蛋白质功能注释进行推理。该组合召回了更多靶点，其中 SEMPER 提供了实验来源的细胞环境信息，补充了大语言模型基于文献的推理。

title: Automating postmarketing pharmacovigilance with large language model agents
zh_title: MedCheckpoint：LLM多智能体自动化上市后药物警戒
summary: medRxiv 预印本提出多智能体 LLM 系统 MedCheckpoint，以可溯源知识库和锁定研究设计参数实现药物警戒分析自动化。
key_points: 分析各阶段锚定可溯源医学知识库
执行前锁定核心研究设计参数以保证可复现
用 54 题基准在模拟环境评测
reason: 预印本新方法，有基准对比但为模拟环境评测、无外部验证，属值得一看档
abstract: Postmarketing pharmacovigilance relies on spontaneous adverse event reporting and labor-intensive observational studies, which suffer from underreporting and delayed risk detection. Large language model (LLM) agents could automate real-world evidence generation, but generalist agents make ad hoc analytical decisions that compromise epidemiological validity and reproducibility. Here we present MedCheckpoint, a multi-agent LLM system for automated postmarketing pharmacovigilance. MedCheckpoint grounds each analytical stage in a curated, source-traceable medical knowledge base, locks core study-design parameters before execution, performs patient-level analyses with human-written deterministic statistical tools, and enforces checkpoint rules that abort infeasible analyses, with optional human-in-the-loop review. We evaluated MedCheckpoint using a 54-question benchmark on a dual-purpose simulated electronic health record (EHR) testbed of 2.7 million individuals, designed with reliable clinical signals to evaluate routine analytical accuracy alongside spurious signals to stress-test system rigor. Across the benchmark, MedCheckpoint outperformed two coding-agent baselines in report quality across five dimensions rated by three independent LLM judges (overall means 4.81-4.88 versus 4.25-4.55 and 4.02-4.29) and yielded higher run-to-run consistency (mean within-question standard deviation 0.116-0.186 versus up to 0.440). Crucially, while baselines failed on up to 2 of 21 runs when handling infeasible comparisons or unmeasurable outcomes, MedCheckpoint produced no misleading failures across all seven stress-test trap questions with known data limitations. MedCheckpoint enables reliable, auditable, and scalable pharmacovigilance analysis.
zh_abstract: 上市后药物警戒依赖自发不良事件报告和劳动密集型的观察性研究，而这类方法存在漏报和风险检测延迟的问题。大语言模型（LLM）智能体有望实现真实世界证据生成的自动化，但通用型智能体会做出临时性的分析决策，从而损害流行病学有效性和可重复性。在此，我们介绍 MedCheckpoint，一种用于自动化上市后药物警戒的多智能体 LLM 系统。MedCheckpoint 将每个分析阶段建立在经过整理、来源可追溯的医学知识库之上，在执行前锁定核心研究设计参数，使用人工编写的确定性统计工具进行患者水平分析，并实施检查点规则以中止不可行的分析，同时可选进行人在回路审查。我们在一个包含 270 万人的双用途模拟电子健康记录（EHR）测试平台上，使用包含 54 个问题的基准对 MedCheckpoint 进行了评估；该测试平台设计了可靠的临床信号以评估常规分析准确性，并设计了虚假信号以压力测试系统的严谨性。在整个基准中，MedCheckpoint 在三位独立 LLM 评审员评定的五个维度上，报告质量优于两个编码智能体基线（总体均值 4.81-4.88 对 4.25-4.55 和 4.02-4.29），并产生了更高的运行间一致性（问题内标准差均值 0.116-0.186 对最高 0.440）。关键的是，当基线在处理不可行比较或不可测量结局时，在 21 次运行中最多有 2 次失败，而 MedCheckpoint 在所有七个具有已知数据局限性的压力测试陷阱问题上均未产生误导性失败。MedCheckpoint 能够实现可靠、可审计且可扩展的药物警戒分析。

title: AToP: An Explainability Framework for Transformer-Based EHR Predictions Using Attribution-Guided Temporal Pattern Mining
zh_title: 基于归因引导时序模式挖掘的 EHR 可解释框架 AToP
summary: 预印本提出 AToP，将 Transformer 的逐 token 积分梯度转为时序模式解释，并在 MIMIC-IV 上验证。
key_points: 基于 MIMIC-IV 21.8 万患者预测 30 天再入院
Transformer 达 AUROC 0.77、PR-AUC 0.34
用掩蔽、逆序、token 忠实性与 KernelSHAP 验证
reason: 大样本但仅内部验证的预印本方法研究，指标中等
abstract: Objective: To develop and evaluate AToP (Attribution to Temporal Patterns), a post-hoc explainability framework that converts per-token Integrated Gradients (IG) from a Transformer into structured temporal pattern narratives. Materials and Methods: AToP was applied to a single-stream Transformer trained on MIMIC-IV v3.1 (218,196 patients; 12.6% unplanned 30-day readmission). It mines frequent episodes from salient-token subsequences in the training cohort, aggregates attribution among patients whose records contain each token or pattern, and collapses near-duplicates by patient overlap. Validation used masking, reversed-order analysis, token-level faithfulness tests, and KernelSHAP comparison. Results: The Transformer achieved AUROC 0.77 and PR-AUC 0.34. Population-weighted attribution emphasized high-prevalence codes with small per-patient impact. Carrier-conditional attribution, the mean among patients with the token, surfaced rare high-attribution psychiatric markers including psychosis, self-harm overdose, suicidal ideation (SI), and severe major depressive disorder (MDD). Pattern-level attribution identified within-visit co-occurrences and cross-visit trajectories not captured by token rankings. Risk-increasing patterns included psychiatric sequences ({MDD, SI} [->] SI) and oncologic progressions (cancer anemia [->] ascites). Obstetric and chest pain evaluation patterns were associated with lower predicted readmission. Discussion: The framework provides two complementary views of model predictions: carrier-conditional aggregation highlights rare, highly attributed clinical features, while temporal pattern analysis identifies within-visit combinations and cross-visit trajectories missed by token-level rankings. Masking and visit-order reversal provided evidence of correspondence with model behavior, but pattern attributions do not represent unique effects or establish clinical validity. Conclusion: AToP turns a Transformer's attributions into visit-anchored temporal pattern narratives, showing which events, in which order, contribute to its readmission predictions.
zh_abstract: 【目的】开发并评估 AToP（Attribution to Temporal Patterns），一种事后可解释性框架，可将来自 Transformer 的逐 token 积分梯度（Integrated Gradients, IG）转换为结构化的时间模式叙述。【材料与方法】将 AToP 应用于在 MIMIC-IV v3.1（218,196 例患者；12.6% 非计划 30 天再入院）上训练的单流 Transformer。它从训练队列中的显著 token 子序列中挖掘频繁事件片段，在记录包含每个 token 或模式的患者中聚合归因，并通过患者重叠合并近重复项。验证使用掩蔽、逆序分析、token 级忠实性测试和 KernelSHAP 比较。【结果】Transformer 达到 AUROC 0.77 和 PR-AUC 0.34。人群加权归因强调了每患者影响较小的高患病率编码。携带者条件归因（即具有该 token 的患者的均值）揭示了罕见的高归因精神科标志物，包括精神病、自伤过量、自杀意念（SI）和重度抑郁症（MDD）。模式级归因识别了 token 排序未捕获的访视内共现和跨访视轨迹。风险增加模式包括精神科序列（{MDD, SI} [->] SI）和肿瘤进展（癌症贫血 [->] 腹水）。产科和胸痛评估模式与较低的预测再入院风险相关。【讨论】该框架提供了模型预测的两种互补视图：携带者条件聚合突出罕见、高归因的临床特征，而时间模式分析识别 token 级排序遗漏的访视内组合和跨访视轨迹。掩蔽和访视顺序逆转提供了与模型行为对应的证据，但模式归因并不代表独特效应，也不能确立临床有效性。【结论】AToP 将 Transformer 的归因转换为以访视锚定的时间模式叙述，显示哪些事件、以何种顺序对其再入院预测有贡献。

title: Do Large Language Models Show Racial and Sex Bias in Pain Management? A Counterfactual Audit of GPT, Claude, Gemini, Llama, DeepSeek and Qwen
zh_title: 大模型在疼痛管理中的种族与性别偏见审计
summary: 对GPT、Claude、Gemini、Llama、DeepSeek、Qwen等17个模型开展反事实审计，考察疼痛处置建议中的种族与性别偏差。
key_points: 研究1让四个开放权重模型评估六种急性疼痛情景
研究2覆盖17个模型、24种配置及50份临床医生撰写的病例
分析为探索性、未预注册，并测量了模型自身回答的稳定性
reason: 多模型公平性审计覆盖较广，但为未预注册的探索性预印本，无外部验证
abstract: Racial and ethnic minority patients receive less pain treatment than non-Hispanic White patients, and large language models (LLMs) used as medical AI could reproduce that bias. Prior audits tested a few proprietary models, stated race explicitly and rarely measured the models' own response instability. In exploratory, non-preregistered analyses, Study 1 had four open-weight LLMs assess six acute-pain vignettes in every combination of four races and two sexes, with identity stated or cued only by a name (two names per group), comparing each identity with a White male reference on the same case and sampling seed. In Study 2, 24 configurations of 17 models, including OpenAI's GPT-4.1 mini and gpt-oss, Anthropic's Claude Haiku 4.5, Google's Gemini 2.5 Flash, Meta's Llama, DeepSeek and Qwen, with reasoning on and off and at two precisions, answered the same vignettes and the 50 clinician-written Q-Pain cases. In this single-prompt, JSON-constrained task, no difference survived correction in Study 1, none of 1,386 comparisons survived the false discovery rate in Study 2, and every pain-severity difference was equivalent to zero within one point on a 0-10 scale (within a quarter point for 237 of 238 Q-Pain comparisons). Opioid decisions were bounded less precisely (Study 1 could not exclude differences of about 20 percentage points), so they show no detected difference, not proof of none. The few differences surviving correction within a model favoured Black patients. Models differed far more from one another and across their own settings than between patients (the reference patient received the high opioid dose in 6% to 93% of responses), although serving software, provider and prompt format also differed. Fairness audits of clinical AI should use several names per group, pair comparisons on the seed, report the noise floor and test each deployed configuration.
zh_abstract: 种族和族裔少数群体患者接受疼痛治疗少于非西班牙裔白人患者，而用作医学 AI 的大型语言模型（LLMs）可能重现这种偏见。此前的审计测试了少数专有模型，明确陈述种族，且很少测量模型自身响应不稳定性。在探索性、非预注册分析中，研究 1 让四个开放权重 LLMs 评估六个急性疼痛情境（vignettes），覆盖四个种族和两个性别的所有组合，身份被明确陈述或仅通过姓名提示（每组两个姓名），并在同一病例和采样种子（seed）上将每个身份与白人男性参照进行比较。在研究 2 中，17 个模型的 24 种配置，包括 OpenAI 的 GPT-4.1 mini 和 gpt-oss、Anthropic 的 Claude Haiku 4.5、Google 的 Gemini 2.5 Flash、Meta 的 Llama、DeepSeek 和 Qwen，在推理开启和关闭以及两种精度下，回答了相同的情境和 50 个临床医生编写的 Q-Pain 病例。在这个单一提示、JSON 约束的任务中，研究 1 中没有差异在校正后仍然存在，研究 2 中 1,386 次比较没有一次在错误发现率校正后仍然存在，并且每个疼痛严重程度差异在 0-10 量表上均等效于零，差异在一个点以内（238 个 Q-Pain 比较中有 237 个在四分之一点以内）。阿片类药物决策的界限较不精确（研究 1 无法排除约 20 个百分点的差异），因此它们显示未检测到差异，而非证明没有差异。在一个模型内校正后仍然存在的少数差异偏向黑人患者。模型之间以及模型自身设置之间的差异远大于患者之间的差异（参照患者在 6% 至 93% 的响应中接受了高阿片剂量），尽管服务软件、提供者和提示格式也不同。临床 AI 的公平性审计应每组使用多个姓名，在种子上配对比较，报告噪声底限，并测试每个部署配置。

title: MAGIC: Modality-Aware Gini Inspection for Clinical Hallucination Detection in LMMs
zh_title: MAGIC：多模态注意力分布检测临床幻觉
summary: 预印本提出用基尼系数量化医学多模态大模型生成答案时的模态注意力分布，以检测临床幻觉。
key_points: 将幻觉检测建模为模态注意力分布失衡
用基尼系数量化各层注意力集中度
幻觉回答中视文注意力分配显著改变
reason: 预印本新方法有统计依据但缺外部验证，属值得一看档
abstract: Recent advances in medical large multimodal models (LMMs) have brought promising progress to clinical decision support, yet hallucination, the generation of confident but clinically unverifiable outputs, poses a critical threat to the reliability demanded in high-stakes medical settings. Existing hallucination detection methods, predominantly designed for unimodal settings, fail to capture the visual-linguistic dynamics inherent to medical imaging. We formulate the problem of hallucination detection in LMMs as disproportionate distribution of attention weights across the modalities during answer token generation. We quantify modality-specific attention concentration across layers and heads using the Gini coefficient and demonstrate statistically significant redistribution of attention mass between visual and textual tokens in hallucinated responses. We leverage these features to train a logistic regression-based classifier and evaluate it on two medical LMMs across three medical imaging modalities, demonstrating that our method achieves competitive or superior performance against contemporary hallucination detection baselines.
zh_abstract: 医学大型多模态模型（LMMs）的最新进展为临床决策支持带来了可喜的进步，但幻觉——即生成自信却在临床上无法验证的输出——对高风险医疗场景所要求的可靠性构成严重威胁。现有的幻觉检测方法主要针对单模态设置设计，未能捕捉医学影像中固有的视觉-语言动态。我们将LMMs中的幻觉检测问题表述为答案词元（token）生成过程中注意力权重跨模态分布不均衡。我们使用基尼系数（Gini coefficient）量化跨层和跨注意力头的模态特异性注意力集中度，并证明在幻觉回答中，视觉词元与文本词元之间的注意力质量发生统计学显著的重分布。我们利用这些特征训练了一个基于逻辑回归的分类器，并在两个医学LMMs、三种医学影像模态上对其进行评估，证明我们的方法相较当代幻觉检测基线取得有竞争力或更优的性能。

title: Read and Ignore: What Self-Directed LLM Agents Do in Public Service Scenarios
zh_title: 读与忽略：自主LLM智能体在公共服务场景中的行为
summary: arXiv预印本构建四个专家验证的公共服务场景，采集10个LLM共2400条轨迹，比较其自主行为与产出。
key_points: 四类公共服务场景经专家验证，含可核查记录与决策选项
十款模型、四种提示条件共2400条轨迹，另设无上下文沙箱对照
开放指令下96.9%会读记录，仅18.7%产出成果或自选任务
reason: 预印本，规模较大的智能体行为评测与基线对比，但非临床研究、无外部验证
abstract: Underspecified instructions leave LLM agents to decide what to do. In public services, staff write these instructions, but the agent's decisions affect residents, patients, and students. We build four expert-validated public-service scenarios with records and decision levers that can be checked in the files, collect $2{,}400$ trajectories from ten LLMs under four prompt conditions, and compare them with $1{,}000$ runs in a context-free sandbox. Agents read the records in $96.9\%$ of open-ended runs and produce an artifact or a self-chosen task in $18.7\%$; with an explicit task, $86.0\%$ produce. Domain context does not change how many runs produce ($18.7\%$ vs.\ $16.0\%$), and the production ranking of the models largely carries over (Spearman $0.79$), while the ranking by whether a model reads the records does not ($0.19$). Context cuts boundary-probing turns per run by $60\%$, and some artifacts contradict the records. We contribute a test that a public-service institution can run on its own records before procurement; its rule-based taxonomy needs no labeled data, and scenarios, code, and trajectories are released.
zh_abstract: 指令规定不足会使LLM智能体自行决定要做什么。在公共服务中，工作人员编写这些指令，但智能体的决策会影响居民、患者和学生。我们构建了四个经专家验证的公共服务场景，其中包含可在文件中核查的记录和决策杠杆；在四种提示条件下从十个LLM收集了2,400条轨迹，并将其与无上下文沙箱中的1,000次运行进行比较。在开放式运行中，智能体在96.9%的运行中读取记录，并在18.7%的运行中产出制品或自行选择的任务；当有明确任务时，86.0%会产出。领域上下文并未改变产出运行的占比（18.7% 对 16.0%），模型在产出方面的排名基本延续（Spearman 0.79），而按模型是否读取记录进行的排名则没有延续（0.19）。上下文将每次运行的边界探查轮次减少60%，且部分制品与记录相矛盾。我们贡献了一项公共服务机构可在采购前对自身记录运行的测试；其基于规则的分类体系无需标注数据，场景、代码和轨迹均已发布。

title: Interpreting Selective-Review Coverage for Head-and-Neck Auto-Contours
zh_title: 头颈自动勾画选择性复核的覆盖率解读
summary: 基于Mayo存档记录与OpenKBP分析，指出选择性复核系统的覆盖率会因测量不可用而失真，空预测等不可评估样本大量被放行。
key_points: 区分结构可评估性、计算终点状态与放行决策
3968例Mayo记录中1167例空预测均为终点阴性且被放行
OpenKBP测试中路由模型AUC 0.833但放行全部544例不可评估样本
reason: 预印本评估分析，样本量较大且有留出测试集，但属方法学审计、非前瞻临床验证
abstract: Selective-review systems aim to reduce human review by passing candidates predicted to be low risk. However, coverage (the fraction passed) can be misleading when measurements needed to interpret risk are unavailable. We separate structural evaluability (a nonempty mask with all required measurements available), computational-endpoint status, and pass-or-review decisions using archived Mayo records and controlled OpenKBP analyses. In 3,968 Mayo records, all 1,167 recorded empty predictions (predicted target-organ masks containing zero voxels despite nonempty reference masks) were endpoint-negative and passed both modules, accounting for approximately 76% of each pass set. In a held-out OpenKBP test, a logistic-regression router achieved an area under the receiver operating characteristic curve of 0.833 and average precision of 0.449 but passed all 544 non-evaluable candidates, including 542 prespecified empty-mask controls and 2 erosions that became empty. A structural gate removed those passes without changing scores or the threshold, preserved all evaluable passes, and assigned 98.71% of endpoint-positive candidates to review. Under the original preprocessing and in patient-disjoint development evaluation, a router trained only on evaluable candidates and a router modeling an unavailable state likewise passed no non-evaluable candidates, with similar evaluable discrimination and at least 99.0% of endpoint-positive candidates assigned to review in pooled outer-fold predictions. These results show that coverage should be interpreted jointly with candidate eligibility, endpoint scope, missingness handling, and routing rules; they do not establish clinical validity, deployment safety, or natural-failure prevalence.
zh_abstract: 选择性复核系统旨在通过放行预测为低风险的候选者来减少人工复核。然而，当解释风险所需的测量不可用时，覆盖率（放行比例）可能具有误导性。我们使用归档的Mayo记录和受控的OpenKBP分析，将结构可评估性（非空掩膜且所有所需测量均可用）、计算终点状态以及放行或复核决策分开。在3,968份Mayo记录中，所有1,167个记录到的空预测（预测靶器官掩膜在参考掩膜非空的情况下包含零个体素）均为终点阴性并通过两个模块，约占每个放行集的76%。在留出的OpenKBP测试中，一个逻辑回归路由器达到受试者工作特征曲线下面积0.833和平均精度0.449，但放行了全部544个不可评估候选者，包括542个预设空掩膜对照和2个变为空的腐蚀。一个结构门控在不改变分数或阈值的情况下移除了这些放行，保留了所有可评估的放行，并将98.71%的终点阳性候选者分配至复核。在原始预处理下以及在患者不交叉的开发评估中，仅在可评估候选者上训练的路由器和对不可用状态建模的路由器同样未放行任何不可评估候选者，具有相似的可评估判别能力，并且在汇总外折预测中至少99.0%的终点阳性候选者被分配至复核。这些结果表明，覆盖率应与候选者资格、终点范围、缺失处理以及路由规则联合解释；这些结果并未确立临床有效性、部署安全性或自然失败发生率。

title: DETER: Suppression During Pretraining for Tamper Resistance
zh_title: DETER：预训练阶段抑制知识以增强抗篡改性
summary: 预印本提出在预训练中插入梯度上升抑制生物/医学知识，比仅过滤语料或事后遗忘更难被微调恢复。
key_points: 针对开放权重模型的生物、化学、网络滥用风险
过滤语料基础上加入梯度上升可提高再获取难度
1B 模型恢复 PubMed 损失需逾 20 倍微调 token
reason: 有新方法且有过滤/事后遗忘基线对比，但为预印本、无外部验证
abstract: Open-weight language models can acquire knowledge that could enable biological, chemical, or cyber misuse. Any attempt to limit such knowledge must remain effective after the model weights are released and can be fine-tuned. Unlearning applied after pretraining can be rapidly undone, whereas filtering the pretraining corpus offers greater resistance. We ask whether actively suppressing knowledge during pretraining can further increase the fine-tuning required to acquire it. Even simple gradient ascent interleaved with standard pretraining on the filtered corpus makes medical knowledge harder to acquire through adversarial fine-tuning than filtering alone or post-hoc unlearning. At 1B parameters, reaching the held-out PubMed loss of an unfiltered model requires over 20$\times$ as many PubMed fine-tuning tokens as after filtering alone. Retained knowledge is evaluated using both held-out data and downstream tasks. Across model sizes, varying suppression strength reveals an increasingly favorable trade-off between fine-tuning difficulty and held-out loss on retained pretraining data. These results point to pretraining as an effective stage for making unwanted capabilities harder to acquire through subsequent fine-tuning. Code is available at \href{https://github.com/MEGlr/DETER}{\texttt{github.com/MEGlr/DETER}}.
zh_abstract: 开放权重语言模型可以习得可能促成生物、化学或网络滥用的知识。任何限制此类知识的尝试都必须在模型权重发布并可被微调后仍然有效。预训练后应用的去学习（unlearning）可被迅速撤销，而过滤预训练语料库具有更强的抵抗力。我们考察在预训练期间主动抑制知识是否能进一步增加获取该知识所需的微调量。即使将简单的梯度上升与过滤语料库上的标准预训练交错进行，也会使医学知识比仅过滤或事后去学习更难通过对抗性微调获得。在 1B 参数下，要达到未过滤模型的留出 PubMed 损失，所需的 PubMed 微调 token 数超过仅过滤后的 20 倍。保留知识使用留出数据和下游任务进行评估。跨模型规模，变化抑制强度揭示出微调难度与保留预训练数据上的留出损失之间越来越有利的权衡。这些结果表明，预训练是使不良能力更难通过后续微调获得的有效阶段。代码见 github.com/MEGlr/DETER。

title: Discharge Summary Generation Is Not Just Summarization: A Reality Check for Evaluation
zh_title: 出院小结生成不只是摘要：评估框架再审视
summary: 预印本提出证据感知的事实级评估框架 FairSumEval，区分可溯源事实与参考独有内容的匹配与遗漏。
key_points: 在200例MIMIC-III入院记录上评估
18.8%医师参考事实无输入证据支持
提出Soft IoU-S与Soft IoU-NS两项指标
reason: 评估方法有新意、切中临床NLP痛点，但仅单数据集预印本
abstract: Discharge summaries combine a retrospective account of hospitalization with discharge-time decisions. Physician-written references therefore contain both facts supported by prior clinical notes and reference-only content, potentially reflecting clinical synthesis, handoffs, or discharge planning. Reference-only evaluation can conflate failure to recover available information with failure to reproduce content absent from the model input. We introduce FairSumEval, an evidence-aware, fact-level framework that assesses whether each reference and generated fact is supported by the model's evidence and captured by the other summary. The resulting outcome map separates matches, omissions, and additions. Two complementary metrics, Soft IoU-S and Soft IoU-NS, measure reference-generation agreement for facts with and without identified evidence support. On 200 MIMIC-III admissions, 18.8% of physician reference facts have identified support in the prior evidence, compared with 65.4% and 63.5% of facts generated by a general-purpose and a medically specialized model. Overlap is substantially higher for supported content (0.255 and 0.236) than for content without identified support (0.030 and 0.026). The two scores are weakly correlated across admissions (rho = 0.22 and 0.17), and conventional metrics do not consistently capture both dimensions. FairSumEval distinguishes evidence-grounded summarization from agreement on content without identified support, revealing what models omit and add in each category.
zh_abstract: 出院小结将住院过程的回顾性叙述与出院时决策结合起来。因此，医生撰写的参考摘要既包含有既往临床记录支持的事实，也包含仅存在于参考摘要中的内容，后者可能反映临床综合、交接或出院计划。仅针对参考摘要的评估可能把未能恢复可得信息与未能复现模型输入中不存在的内容混为一谈。我们提出 FairSumEval，一个证据感知、事实级框架，用于评估每条参考事实和生成事实是否得到模型证据支持并被另一份摘要捕获。由此得到的结果图将匹配、遗漏和新增分开。两个互补指标 Soft IoU-S 和 Soft IoU-NS 衡量有和没有已识别证据支持的事实在参考摘要与生成摘要之间的一致性。在 200 次 MIMIC-III 入院中，18.8% 的医生参考事实在既往证据中有已识别支持，而通用模型和医学专用模型生成的事实中分别有 65.4% 和 63.5% 有已识别支持。对有支持内容的重叠（0.255 和 0.236）显著高于对无已识别支持内容的重叠（0.030 和 0.026）。两个评分在入院间弱相关（rho = 0.22 和 0.17），常规指标不能一致地捕捉这两个维度。FairSumEval 将有证据依据的摘要与对无已识别支持内容的一致性区分开来，揭示模型在每个类别中遗漏和新增了什么。

title: Artificial intelligence in dermatophytosis: Toward better clinical diagnosis and management.
zh_title: 人工智能在皮肤癣菌病诊疗中的应用综述
summary: 综述总结机器学习与深度学习在皮肤癣菌病的临床照片、无创皮肤成像与实验室诊断中的应用。
key_points: 覆盖临床照片与无创皮肤成像分析
涉及实验室诊断及治疗与随访支持
提及患者教育与用药依从性管理
reason: 综述类上限6分；属领域应用梳理，无新数据或系统评价，属增量档
abstract: [Journal de mycologie medicale] Dermatophytosis is one of the most common superficial fungal infections worldwide. However, its diagnosis and management remain challenging because its clinical manifestations often overlap with those of other dermatoses, conventional mycological tests have inherent limitations, the disease is prone to recurrence, and antifungal resistance has received increasing attention. This review summarizes current applications of artificial intelligence (AI) in dermatophytosis, with a focus on the use of machine learning and deep learning in clinical photographs, non-invasive skin imaging, and laboratory diagnostics, while also discussing their roles in treatment support, follow-up assessment, patient education, and adherence management. In addition, with the accumulation of molecular diagnostic, mass spectrometric, and epidemiological data, AI may also provide auxiliary support for extended applications such as resistance risk recognition. Current evidence suggests that AI can improve the efficiency, consistency, and objectivity of dermatophytosis diagnosis and provide quantitative support for treatment response assessment and long-term follow-up. With further improvement in research quality and the accumulation of clinical application experience, AI is expected to become increasingly integrated into dermatophytosis management workflows.
zh_abstract: [Journal de mycologie medicale] 皮肤癣菌病是全世界最常见的浅表真菌感染之一。然而，其诊断和管理仍然具有挑战性，因为其临床表现常与其他皮肤病重叠，传统真菌学检查存在固有局限性，该病易于复发，且抗真菌药物耐药性日益受到关注。本综述总结了人工智能（AI）在皮肤癣菌病中的当前应用，重点关注机器学习和深度学习在临床照片、无创皮肤成像和实验室诊断中的应用，同时讨论其在治疗支持、随访评估、患者教育和依从性管理中的作用。此外，随着分子诊断、质谱和流行病学数据的积累，AI还可能为耐药风险识别等扩展应用提供辅助支持。当前证据表明，AI可以提高皮肤癣菌病诊断的效率、一致性和客观性，并为治疗反应评估和长期随访提供定量支持。随着研究质量的进一步提高和临床应用经验的积累，AI有望日益融入皮肤癣菌病管理工作流程。

The main questions it aims to answer are: * Does AI-assisted remote symptom monitoring reduce the proportion of patients who experience at least one hospital admission due to MBO within 90 days? * Does AI-assisted remote symptom monitoring improve patient-reported outcomes, quality of life, healthcare resource utilization, and survival outcomes compared with standard care? Researchers will compare AI-assisted remote symptom monitoring plus standard care with standard care alone to determine whether remote monitoring can reduce MBO-related hospital admissions and improve patient outcomes. Participants will receive study-specific assessments and follow-up for at least 90 days. Participants in the monitoring group will receive regular automated symptom-monitoring calls, and optional stool samples may be collected for microbiome research

title: Prior-informed machine learning for clinically interpretable medical diagnosis.
source: PubMed · Frontiers in bioengineering and biotechnology
zh_title: 先验知识嵌入的可解释医学诊断机器学习
summary: 提出PIML框架，以贝叶斯推断融合临床先验与数据驱动模型，在三个临床数据集上验证可解释诊断。

将敏感度/特异度要求嵌入模型开发

reason: 方法类论文，摘要未见对照与外部验证细节，属增量档
abstract: [Frontiers in bioengineering and biotechnology] Traditional machine learning (ML) in medical diagnostics often suffers from limited clinical interpretability and poor generalization, owing to its black-box, data-driven nature. Here, we present Prior-Informed Machine Learning (PIML), a framework that integrates clinically grounded generative reasoning with data-driven, ML-enabled discriminative modeling through Bayesian inference to provide clinically interpretable, patient-specific diagnostic outcomes. By embedding the optimization of sensitivity and specificity in data-driven diagnosis-requirements for subsequent Bayesian inference-directly into the ML model development process, PIML enables a synergistic integration of machine learning and clinical expertise that cannot be achieved through either data-driven or clinically grounded approaches alone. PIML was validated across three clinical domains-cervical neoplasia detection, high-risk oral lesion detection, and preterm birth detection-where Bayesian inference was systematically employed to integrate electrical impedance spectroscopy (EIS)-based machine learning with domain-specific clinical expertise, thereby enabling more comprehensive and enhanced diagnostic decision-making. Our results demonstrate that PIML generally improves diagnostic performance compared with standard ML approaches and provides competitive or superior performance relative to knowledge-based and feature-level prior integration strategies. This work presents an innovative, systematic framework with strong potential for widespread adoption in addressing medical diagnostic challenges across heterogeneous clinical environments.
zh_abstract: [Frontiers in bioengineering and biotechnology] 传统医学诊断中的机器学习（machine learning, ML）常因黑箱、数据驱动的特性而临床可解释性有限且泛化能力差。在此，我们提出先验知情机器学习（Prior-Informed Machine Learning, PIML），该框架通过贝叶斯推断将基于临床的生成式推理与数据驱动的、由 ML 实现的判别式建模相结合，以提供临床可解释的、患者特异性的诊断结果。通过将数据驱动诊断中对敏感性和特异性的优化需求——用于后续贝叶斯推断——直接嵌入 ML 模型开发过程，PIML 实现了机器学习与临床专业知识的协同整合，这是仅靠数据驱动或仅靠临床基础方法都无法实现的。PIML 在三个临床领域得到验证——宫颈肿瘤检测、高危口腔病变检测和早产检测——在这些领域中系统性地使用贝叶斯推断，将基于电阻抗光谱（electrical impedance spectroscopy, EIS）的机器学习与领域特定临床专业知识整合，从而促成更全面和增强的诊断决策。我们的结果表明，与标准 ML 方法相比，PIML 总体改善了诊断性能，并且相对于基于知识和特征级先验整合策略提供了有竞争力或更优的性能。这项工作提出了一个创新、系统的框架，在应对异构临床环境中的医学诊断挑战方面具有广泛采用的强大潜力。

abstract: Academic, psychosocial, financial, environmental, and interpersonal factors are widely recognized as important contributors to the overall wellbeing of students. This study aimed to identify factors associated with the psychological wellbeing of university undergraduates and compare the performance of machine learning models for binary and multiclass classification of wellbeing status using self-reported survey data from undergraduates at the University of Peradeniya, Sri Lanka. The findings may facilitate the early identification of students with lower wellbeing and inform targeted interventions to foster a healthier and more supportive academic environment. Cross-sectional questionnaire data from 2,913 undergraduates were analyzed to classify psychological wellbeing using overall happiness scores. Scores were grouped into binary (1-5 and 6-9) and multiclass (1-4, 5-6, and 7-9) categories. Data preprocessing included missing value imputation, one-hot encoding, and feature scaling where appropriate. Support Vector Machine (SVM), Random Forest (RF), XGBoost (XGB), and Multilayer Perceptron (MLP) models were trained using repeated stratified 10-fold cross-validation and evaluated using macro F1-score, ROC-AUC, and classification reports. SHAP analysis was employed to interpret feature contributions and enhance model interpretability. XGB achieved the highest macro-F1 score (70.5%) for binary classification, with a test accuracy of 72.5%. The model correctly classified 63.6% and 80% of participants in the lower and higher psychological wellbeing groups, respectively. For multiclass classification, RF achieved the highest macro-F1 score (54.6%), with a test accuracy of 56.5%. The model correctly classified 48%, 57%, and 60% of participants in the lower, intermediate, and higher psychological wellbeing groups, respectively. SHAP analysis identified academic coping, health and wellbeing, financial circumstances, and interpersonal relationships as key predictors of psychological wellbeing across both models. These findings demonstrate the potential of machine learning to classify psychological wellbeing groups using self-reported data, supporting early identification of students at risk of poor wellbeing and informing targeted university-level mental health interventions.
zh_abstract: 学术、心理社会、经济、环境和人际因素被广泛认为是学生整体福祉的重要贡献因素。本研究旨在识别与大学本科生心理健康福祉相关的因素，并比较机器学习模型使用斯里兰卡佩拉德尼亚大学本科生自我报告调查数据对福祉状态进行二分类和多分类分类的性能。研究结果可能有助于早期识别福祉较低的学生，并为针对性干预提供信息，以培养更健康、更具支持性的学术环境。分析了来自 2,913 名本科生的横断面问卷数据，使用总体幸福感评分对心理健康福祉进行分类。评分被分为二分类（1-5 和 6-9）和多分类（1-4、5-6 和 7-9）类别。数据预处理包括缺失值插补、独热编码以及适当情况下的特征缩放。支持向量机（Support Vector Machine, SVM）、随机森林（Random Forest, RF）、XGBoost（XGB）和多层感知机（Multilayer Perceptron, MLP）模型使用重复分层 10 折交叉验证进行训练，并使用宏 F1 分数、ROC-AUC 和分类报告进行评估。采用 SHAP 分析解释特征贡献并增强模型可解释性。XGB 在二分类中取得最高宏 F1 分数（70.5%），测试准确率为 72.5%。该模型分别正确分类了较低和较高心理健康福祉组中 63.6% 和 80% 的参与者。对于多分类，RF 取得最高宏 F1 分数（54.6%），测试准确率为 56.5%。该模型分别正确分类了较低、中等和较高心理健康福祉组中 48%、57% 和 60% 的参与者。SHAP 分析确定学术应对、健康与福祉、经济状况和人际关系是两个模型中心理健康福祉的关键预测因素。这些发现证明了机器学习使用自我报告数据对心理健康福祉组进行分类的潜力，支持早期识别有福祉不良风险的学生，并为大学层面的针对性心理健康干预提供信息。

abstract: Liver disease remains a major global health concern, highlighting the need for reliable and accessible early detection methods. Although recent advances in machine learning, deep learning and quantum machine learning (QML) have introduced promising diagnostic tools, many approaches suffer from limited interpretability and inflated performance caused by data leakage or overly simplistic evaluation protocols. These constraints reduce their reliability in real-world clinical practice. This paper proposes KQML-Liver, a hybrid framework that integrates QML with Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks (KANs) to enhance predictive performance and interpretability. The architecture combines parameterized quantum circuits for expressive feature representation with KAN-based functional mappings that capture nonlinear relationships in an interpretable manner. Evaluated on the Indian Liver Patient Dataset (ILPD) under a rigorous preprocessing protocol preventing data leakage, the proposed model achieves 82% classification accuracy and 100% recall, detecting all positive cases, outperforming existing baselines while providing improved transparency in clinical predictions. These results suggest that hybrid KAN-quantum architectures offer a promising direction for interpretable AI-assisted medical diagnosis.
zh_abstract: 肝病仍是全球重大健康问题，凸显了对可靠且可及的早期检测方法的需求。尽管机器学习、深度学习和量子机器学习（QML）的最新进展带来了有前景的诊断工具，但许多方法存在可解释性有限以及由数据泄漏或过于简单的评估方案导致的性能虚高问题。这些限制降低了它们在真实世界临床实践中的可靠性。本文提出KQML-Liver，一种将QML与Kolmogorov-Arnold网络（KANs）集成的混合框架，以提升预测性能和可解释性。该架构将用于表达性特征表示的参数化量子电路与基于KAN的函数映射相结合，后者以可解释的方式捕捉非线性关系。在严格防止数据泄漏的预处理方案下，在Indian Liver Patient Dataset（ILPD）上评估时，所提模型达到82%的分类准确率和100%的召回率，检测出所有阳性病例，优于现有基线，同时在临床预测中提供更好的透明度。这些结果表明，混合KAN-量子架构为可解释的AI辅助医学诊断提供了有前景的方向。

abstract: Radiotherapy contour ranking can support quality assurance, but vision-language model (VLM) gains may reflect supervision, score construction, available inputs, or representation access. We evaluated frozen MedGemma 1.5 in a single-institution study, a 12-patient held-out HaN-Seg test, five-fold cross-fitting on 30 non-test HaN-Seg patients, and transfer without refitting to 120 SegRap2023 patients. On held-out HaN-Seg, a supervised readout of the final prompt state exceeded a supervised readout of the model's yes/no output probabilities by +0.3047 pooled average precision (AP; 95% patient-bootstrap interval [+0.2822, +0.3269]); the advantage persisted against a parameter-count-matched nonlinear control. A readout of projected visual tokens exceeded the final-state readout in cross-fitting and transfer (+0.0706 AP averaged equally across patients on SegRap; 95% interval [+0.0607, +0.0804]), while a structured panel-feature readout remained competitive with visual tokens. The anatomy-conditioned readout did not demonstrate an advantage over the native-feature comparator. These results motivate visual-token and structured-feature controls in medical-imaging VLM evaluations; outcomes were computational or synthetic, not clinical acceptability.

abstract: Hydration influences physiology and daily function, yet repeated practical measurement in everyday settings remains limited. We present initial real-world evidence that a facial-video lifestyle digital biomarker score can track the direction of hydration state transitions. Using Ramadan fasting as a model of prolonged fluid abstinence, we assessed whether the score tracks the transition between the fasting (pre-drink) state and the rehydrated (post-drink) state across three validation layers. In the primary cohort (104 participants, 208 videos), the score increased from a mean of 36.6 in the fasting (pre-drink) state to 70.6 in the rehydrated (post-drink) state (change = +33.9, 95% CI [+30.7, +37.1], p < 0.001, Cohen's d = 2.03), with 102 of 104 participants (98.1%) showing an upward shift. In a nested body-weight subgroup (20 participants), body weight increased by +0.74 kg after fluid intake (p < 0.001), confirming fluid uptake and providing supportive physical anchoring. In a nested serum osmolality subgroup (10 participants), osmolality decreased by -5.1 mOsm/kg (p < 0.001), with all post-drink values within the normal clinical range, providing exploratory biological support. An exploratory secondary comparison of water versus electrolyte rehydration showed no statistically significant difference in short-term score change (p = 0.247). This study does not establish a clinical diagnostic test for dehydration. Rather, these findings support the score as a lifestyle digital biomarker for tracking the direction of hydration state change in real-world settings.
zh_abstract: 水合状态影响生理和日常功能，但在日常环境中重复进行实用测量仍然有限。我们提供初步的真实世界证据，表明面部视频生活方式数字生物标志物评分可以追踪水合状态转变的方向。以斋月禁食作为长时间液体戒断的模型，我们在三个验证层中评估该评分是否能追踪禁食（饮水前）状态与补液后（饮水后）状态之间的转变。在主要队列（104 名参与者，208 段视频）中，评分从禁食（饮水前）状态的平均 36.6 上升到补液后（饮水后）状态的 70.6（变化 = +33.9，95% CI [+30.7, +37.1]，p < 0.001，Cohen's d = 2.03），104 名参与者中有 102 名（98.1%）出现上升变化。在一个嵌套体重亚组（20 名参与者）中，液体摄入后体重增加 +0.74 kg（p < 0.001），确认液体摄取并提供支持性的物理锚定。在一个嵌套血清渗透压亚组（10 名参与者）中，渗透压下降 -5.1 mOsm/kg（p < 0.001），所有饮水后数值均在正常临床范围内，提供探索性生物学支持。一项探索性二次比较显示，水与电解质补液在短期评分变化上无统计学显著差异（p = 0.247）。本研究并未确立针对脱水的临床诊断测试。相反，这些发现支持将该评分作为一种生活方式数字生物标志物，用于追踪真实世界环境中水合状态变化的方向。
